name: hnnx
description: Visualize, analyze, and edit ONNX models with AIMET encoding support, including remote workspaces.

hnnx.autoPinOnnxEditors.description: Keep ONNX editor tabs open so switching to another file does not discard and reload the graph.

hnnx.autoLoadEncodings.description: Automatically load a conventionally named AIMET encodings file from the ONNX model directory when the model opens.

hnnx.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python interpreter containing `onnx` and NVIDIA `onnx_graphsurgeon`. In remote workspaces this path is resolved on the remote extension host. Use the **HNNX: Configure GraphSurgeon Python** command to validate and save it.

enumDescriptions: Follow the active VS Code color theme.
Always use the HNNX light theme.
Always use the HNNX dark theme.
hnnx.colorTheme.description: Controls the HNNX graph viewer color theme.

scripts.package: npm run build:media && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out hnnx-0.1.13.vsix
